mapper.select: SELECT ware.client_id AS clientID, user.user_name AS clientName, user.business_number AS clientBusinessNumber, ware.ware_start_date AS startDate, ware.ware_end_date AS endDate, ware.ware_id AS wareId, concat(ware.warehouse_pos_x,ware.warehouse_pos_y) AS wareCoord, wareinfo.rental_fee AS wareFee FROM userWareHouse ware JOIN user ON ware.client_id = user.client_id JOIN wareHouse wareinfo ON ware.ware_id = wareinfo.ware_id and ware.warehouse_pos_x = wareinfo.warehouse_pos_x and ware.warehouse_pos_y = wareinfo.warehouse_pos_y
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (client_id, user_name, business_number, user_phone,user_email,user_address,user_enterdate,user_id,user_pw,user_status) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{userName}, #{businessNumber}, #{userPhone},#{userEmail},#{userAddress},now(),#{userId},#{userPw},#{userStatus});
